t: Apollo Comms Part 1: Opening the S-Band Transponder and Amplifier

q.x: Daniel Estévez ( [link] ) has lots of interesting blog posts on using tools like GNU Radio and Jupiter to decode transmissions from various objects in space. He's recently also been looking at LTE.

recs.x: Apollo instead used pseudo-random code for ranging. CuriousMarc have great ongoing series on restoring Apollo S-band equipment: [link]

recs.stt: Ask HN: Which protocols and data formats are used for space communication?
recs.x:
Daniel Estévez ( [link] ) has lots of interesting blog posts on using tools like GNU Radio and Jupiter to decode transmissions from various objects in space. He's recently also been looking at LTE.

I would also recommend CuriousMarc who has done a lot of work with his friends on restoring some radio equipment from the Apollo missions: [link] 
There are lots of good explanations of the how and why in those videos.
